method: The decision rests on coverage-v1332f on candidate 1214cp under the product controller: Corvo (host) is granted Possession and its parasite upgrade by name (lab-only coop_grant_named; the isolated save has neither), stands 1 m in front of the upper-floor guard, casts with the native left trigger, occupies the guard and leaves with the left trigger again. The partner is checked from its own power presentation and the possession body-visibility status on the observer (hide and show calls), and the checkpoint is reloaded afterwards. The empty-target entry and aim were already presented in coverage-v1332c/d. The possessed guard's motion in the partner world follows the host-owned NPC stream (stage 4).

items.scope: Corvo possesses a human guard and leaves: the partner presents the cast (power variants 26-28), hides Corvo's body while he occupies the guard (one hide), and shows it again where he leaves the host (one show, original visibility restored).

visual.verdict: Corvo thrusts his arm toward the guard and vanishes; for about three seconds only the guard is seen, then Corvo reappears beside him and stands.
